python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
CST=timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
today='2026-09-11'
root=Path('/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts')

def extract_user_queries(p):
  out=[]
  for line in p.open(errors='ignore'):
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    role=o.get('role') or (o.get('message') or {}).get('role')
    # cursor format may nest
    msg=o.get('message') or o
    if isinstance(msg, dict):
      role=msg.get('role') or role
      c=msg.get('content')
    else:
      c=o.get('content')
    if role!='user': continue
    text=''
    if isinstance(c,str): text=c
    elif isinstance(c,list):
      for x in c:
        if isinstance(x,dict) and x.get('type')=='text': text+=x.get('text','')
        elif isinstance(x,str): text+=x
    m=re.search(r'<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>', text, re.S)
    if m: text=m.group(1).strip()
    else:
      # skip tool/system wrappers
      if 'user_info' in text or 'available_skills' in text or 'agent_transcripts' in text: continue
      text=text.strip()
    if not text or len(text)<2: continue
    if text.startswith('Briefly inform'): continue
    if 'AGENT_LOOP' in text: continue
    out.append(text[:300].replace('\n',' '))
  return out

for p in sorted(root.rglob('*.jsonl'), key=lambda x:x.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True):
  mt=datetime.fromtimestamp(p.stat().st_mtime, CST)
  if mt.date().isoformat()!=today: continue
  qs=extract_user_queries(p)
  if not qs: continue
  print(f'\n=== {mt.strftime("%H:%M")} {p.parent.name[:8]}/{p.name[:12]} n={len(qs)} ===')
  for q in qs[-25:]:
    print('-', q[:220])
PY
